title: Does depth 8 or 12 improve the shared-query Transformer?
question: Does increasing depth from4 to8 or12 reduce validation MAE with the existing fixed training recipe?
configuration: SPX-PX6-GRID5-v1: 204,694 training /40,548 validation; width128, four heads, FFN512, six supervised outputs. Reuse completed depth4; sequential depth8/12 on one H200, each batch204,694 and1,000 updates. Exact optimizer/schedule, checkpointing and selection retained.
finding: Depth4 completed with selected mean validation MAE11.689790bp. Depth8/12 are prepared; no depth comparison result yet.
limitations: One fit per depth with one fixed optimization recipe. Reused validation selects checkpoints/depth; intervals do not adjust selection. Equal updates are not equal compute. No reserved test.
